name: vix_filtered_index_trend_v133
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When India VIX is actively rising (positive rate-of-change over 2 minutes), institutional options desks are increasing hedging demand faster than market makers can absorb, forcing market makers to delta-hedge their growing short-gamma exposure by trading NIFTY spot/futures in the prevailing direction — creating a self-reinforcing directional push. A fresh EMA crossover (2-min fast vs 7-min slow) during VIX acceleration confirms that hedge-driven flow is strong enough to shift the short-term NIFTY trend. Unlike v124's static VIX>21 filter and v126's VIX 12-22 band, this version detects VIX acceleration (the transition moment when the regime is shifting), capturing the initial push before the move becomes consensus and followers pile in.

indicators.name: ema_fast_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute fast EMA — trade TRIGGER. Not 9*12=108 (that would be the 9-min original, far too slow). Not 1-min like v124 (too fast, noisy). 2-min (24 bars) is chosen because we hold 15-120s: a 2-minute EMA crossing during VIX acceleration detects genuine direction shift, not a 5-second spike, while still leading the 7-min slow EMA fast enough to enter near the start of the institutional delta-hedge flow.

indicators.name: ema_slow_84
indicators.purpose: 7-minute slow EMA — context FILTER. Distinct from v124's 5-min (60 bars) and v126's 9-min (108 bars). 7 minutes (84 bars) provides a stable trend direction anchor that is slower than the 2-min trigger but faster than v126's 9-min — appropriate because rising VIX regimes have faster trend reversals than calm sessions, so the slow EMA needs to be somewhat responsive.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: VWAP(typical_price, volume) cumulative from session open
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP resets daily from 09:15 — no scaling needed, cumulative measure. Confirms that the EMA crossover aligns with the day's dominant institutional flow direction. In rising-VIX regimes, VWAP acts as the institutional accumulation/distribution level; trades above VWAP signal buy-side dominance, below signal sell-side.

indicators.name: vix_roc_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute VIX rate-of-change — the KEY differentiator from v124 and v126. Detects when VIX is actively accelerating upward (options demand surging), which is the exact moment market makers are forced to delta-hedge aggressively. A static VIX level (v124: >21, v126: 12-22) fires long after the regime is established; VIX ROC fires at the onset. 24-bar window (2 min) is chosen to match our 2-min EMA trigger — both signals detect the same 2-minute acceleration window.

conditions: vix_close >= vix_min (default 17.0) — base level ensures we're in a regime with meaningful hedging pressure
vix_roc_24 >= vix_roc_threshold (default 0.05, i.e., VIX rising 5% over 2 min) — active acceleration
EMA(24) freshly crosses above EMA(84) by > ema_gap_threshold (default 0.02% of close)
close > session_VWAP — buy-side in control of day's flow
buy_ce.confirmation: All 4 conditions on the same 5-second bar; crossover detected as prev bar ema_diff <= 0, current bar ema_diff > gap_threshold * close

conditions: vix_roc_24 >= vix_roc_threshold (default 0.05) — VIX still rising; delta-hedge pressure is symmetric
EMA(24) freshly crosses below EMA(84) by > ema_gap_threshold
buy_pe.confirmation: All 4 conditions on the same 5-second bar; crossunder detected as prev bar ema_diff >= 0, current bar ema_diff < -gap_threshold * close

exit.stop_rationale: Rising VIX regimes produce wider NIFTY swings than stable regimes — typical 30s move in VIX-accelerating sessions is 4-8 spot pts. 5 option pts (~10 spot pts at delta 0.5) gives room for 1 standard swing before invalidating the thesis; if price retraces 10 spot pts against a fresh EMA crossover with VIX rising, the delta-hedge flow has reversed and we exit.
exit.target_rationale: VIX-acceleration-driven delta-hedge flows on NIFTY typically extend 20-40 spot pts in the first 60-120 seconds as market makers complete their hedge. 8 option pts (~16 spot pts) captures 40-80% of the expected initial leg — achievable within the 24-bar (120s) time stop while maintaining meaningful edge over the 5 pt stop.

filters.vix_filter: VIX >= vix_min (default 17.0) AND VIX ROC over 2-min >= 5% — base level plus active acceleration
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST — skip opening 15 min for pre-open noise, flatten before EOD
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume is always sufficient; VIX ROC acts as the activity filter
filters.trend_filter: VWAP direction — CE only above VWAP, PE only below VWAP
filters.spread_filter: none — limit orders at candle close, no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — VIX acceleration patterns are driven by structural market-maker positioning; stable medium-term but sensitive to changes in options market liquidity

adaptation_notes: Original traded top-50 nifty200 stocks with EMA(9)/EMA(21) on 15-minute bars, holding 5-15 bars (75-225 min). The equity universe and stock selection were incidental — the signal logic (VIX regime + EMA crossover + VWAP) is purely index-applicable. Key changes: (1) Universe collapsed to NIFTY index directly — no stock selection; (2) EMA periods changed to 24/84 (2-min/7-min) from 9/21 (15-min/5.25-hr) — we hold 15-120s, not 75-225min, so the lookback must scale with hold time; (3) Static VIX level (>20) replaced with VIX rate-of-change (>5% over 2 min) — this is the fundamental differentiation, detecting regime shift onset rather than settled regime; (4) ATR-based stop replaced with fixed 5 option-pt stop calibrated to VIX-acceleration NIFTY move magnitudes; (5) Lower win rate (original: 0.42) compensated by 1.6:1 winner/loser ratio at faster cadence.
weaknesses: VIX data is forward-filled at 5s resolution — intraday VIX acceleration signals may lag actual options market by 1-3 seconds
Rapid VIX spikes (>5% in 2 min) can also occur during mean-reverting panic tops, generating false crossover signals
In genuine VIX acceleration events, NIFTY may gap rather than trend smoothly, making limit-order fills at candle close suboptimal
Trade frequency may be low — the combination of VIX base level + ROC + EMA crossover + VWAP will filter most bars
